theorem quantization_rigidity_of_finite_residual {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem quantization_rigidity_of_finite_residual {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (hfin : quantizationResidualMeasure hW univ ≠ ∞) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let a := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)
  let β := betaG (quantizationCompletion hW)
  let c := quantizationResidualPhase hW
  let κ := c⁻¹
  let Φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => quantizationTraceF hW (2 * t)
  let Ψ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => quantizationReflectedTraceF hW (2 * t)
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Φ t - Ψ t
  let e := quantizationReflectionError hW
  have hΦm : Measurable Φ :=
    (measurable_quantizationTraceF hW).comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
  have hΨm : Measurable Ψ :=
    (measurable_quantizationReflectedTraceF hW).comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
  have hem : Measurable e := measurable_quantizationReflectionError hW
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hB⟩ := exists_quantization_trace_pair_bound hW
  have hΦb : ∀ t, ‖Φ t‖ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by
    intro t
    have := (hB t).1
    have hp : 0 ≤ C * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hΨb : ∀ t, ‖Ψ t‖ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by
    intro t
    have := (hB t).2
    have hp : 0 ≤ C * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have heb : ∀ t, ‖e t‖ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by
    intro t
    calc ‖e t‖ ≤ ‖Ψ t‖ + ‖c * Φ t‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = ‖Ψ t‖ + ‖Φ t‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_quantizationResidualPhase, one_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by linarith [(hB t).1, (hB t).2]
  have ha := fun σ hσ => quantization_coeff_summable hW (σ := σ) hσ
  have ha2 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖a (n + 1)‖ / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa using summable_sq_of_forall_rpow ha
  let S : ℂ → ℂ := fun τ => ∑' n : ℕ, a (n + 1) * cexp (-(2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * τ))
  let K : ℂ → ℂ := fun τ => -κ * defectLaplace e τ
  have hκ : κ * c = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (quantizationResidualPhase_ne_zero hW)
  have hmain : ∀ τ : ℂ, 0 < τ.re →
      hamburgerSeries a τ = κ * S τ - κ * β / Real.pi / τ + β + K τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    have eA := quantization_hamburgerSeries_reflection hW hτ
    have eB := quantization_hamburgerSeries_eq hW hτ
    have eC := defectLaplace_indicator_eq (g := g) hΨm.aestronglyMeasurable hΨb
      hΦm.aestronglyMeasurable hΦb MeasurableSet.univ (-1)
      (fun t _ => by dsimp [g]; ring) hτ
    have eD := defectLaplace_indicator_eq (g := Ψ) hΦm.aestronglyMeasurable hΦb
      hem.aestronglyMeasurable heb MeasurableSet.univ c
      (fun t _ => by dsimp [e, Ψ, Φ, c, quantizationReflectionError]; ring) hτ
    simp only [indicator_univ] at eC eD
    change hamburgerSeries a τ = S τ - β / (Real.pi * τ) + β + defectLaplace g τ at eA
    change hamburgerSeries a τ = β + defectLaplace Φ τ at eB
    rw [show β / (Real.pi * τ) = β / Real.pi / τ by field_simp] at eA
    dsimp only [K]
    linear_combination κ * eA - (κ - 1) * eB + κ * eC - κ * eD -
      defectLaplace Φ τ * hκ
  have hper : ∀ τ : ℂ, 0 < τ.re → hamburgerSeries a (τ + I) - hamburgerSeries a τ =
      -(κ * β / Real.pi) / (τ + I) - -(κ * β / Real.pi) / τ + (K (τ + I) - K τ) := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hτ' : 0 < (τ + I).re := by simpa using hτ
    have hexp : S (τ + I) = S τ := by
      dsimp only [S]
      refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
      rw [show -(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * (τ + I)) =
        -(2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * τ) + ((-((n : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * I) by
          push_cast; ring, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    rw [hmain τ hτ, hmain (τ + I) hτ', hexp]
    ring
  have hKrad : ∀ m : ℕ, Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) * K ((ε : ℂ) + (m : ℂ) * I))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    intro m
    have h := (tendsto_quantization_reflection_error_radial hW hfin m).const_mul (-κ)
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    exact h.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun ε => by dsimp [K, e]; ring)
  have hK : ∀ n₀ : ℕ, Tendsto (fun τ => (τ - (n₀ : ℂ) * I) * (K (τ + I) - K τ))
      (𝓝[{τ : ℂ | 0 < τ.re}] ((n₀ : ℂ) * I)) (𝓝 0) := by
    intro n₀
    refine tendsto_sub_mul_defect_of_radial ha2 (-(κ * β / Real.pi))
      (fun τ => K (τ + I) - K τ) hper n₀ ?_
    have h := (hKrad (n₀ + 1)).sub (hKrad n₀)
    rw [sub_zero] at h
    refine h.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun ε => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  have hcoef : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = 2 * κ * β := by
    intro n
    have h := coeff_eq_of_hamburgerSeries_periodic_re_pos_of_defect ha2 (-(κ * β / Real.pi))
      (fun τ => K (τ + I) - K τ) hper hK n
    rw [h]
    have hπ : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
    field_simp
  have ha1 : a 1 = 1 := dirichletExp_one (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam)
  have h2β : 2 * κ * β = 1 := by rw [← hcoef 0, ha1]
  have hone : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → a n = 1 := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
    exact (hcoef k).trans h2β

    (fun σ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW (σ := σ) hσ)
    (differentiableOn_weilContinuation hW) (fun s hs => quantizationContinuation_eq_arch hW hs)

## Goal
Λ uniquely maximizes the explicit linear functional `ℓ` over the Weil cone. So the cone lies in a half-space whose boundary it touches only at Λ.

- **(a)** Take `u = Φχ_L`, the truncated kernel.

  unfold sourceZetaPairing sourcePoleNumerator

  ring

    linarith

private theorem exists_sourcePrimitive {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ P : ℂ → ℂ, P 2 = 0 ∧
      ∀ s : ℂ, 1 / 2 < s.re → HasDerivAt P (weilContinuation hW s) s :=
  (GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.isExactOn_rightHalfPlane
    (differentiableOn_weilContinuation hW)).with_val_at 2 0

/-- The primitive of the actual Weil continuation, normalized to zero at two. -/
def sourcePrimitive {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  Classical.choose (exists_sourcePrimitive hW)

@[simp] theorem sourcePrimitive_two {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    sourcePrimitive hW 2 = 0 := (Classical.choose_spec (exists_sourcePrimitive hW)).1

theorem hasDerivAt_sourcePrimitive {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 / 2 < s.re) :
    HasDerivAt (sourcePrimitive hW) (weilContinuation hW s) s :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_sourcePrimitive hW)).2 s hs

theorem sourcePrimitive_conj {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 / 2 < s.re) :
    sourcePrimitive hW (conj s) = conj (sourcePrimitive hW s) := by
  set U : Set ℂ := {z | 1 / 2 < z.re}
  set Q : ℂ → ℂ := conj ∘ sourcePrimitive hW ∘ conj
  have hUo : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
  have hPd : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt (sourcePrimitive hW) (weilContinuation hW z) z :=
    fun z hz => hasDerivAt_sourcePrimitive hW hz
  have hQd : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt Q (weilContinuation hW z) z := by
    intro z hz
    have h := (hasDerivAt_sourcePrimitive hW
      (s := conj z) (by simpa [U] using hz)).conj_conj
    rw [weilContinuation_conj hW hz] at h
    simpa only [Complex.conj_conj] using h
  have heq := hUo.eqOn_of_deriv_eq (convex_halfSpace_re_gt (1 / 2)).isPreconnected
    (fun z hz => (hPd z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun z hz => (hQd z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun z hz => by rw [(hPd z hz).deriv, (hQd z hz).deriv])
    (show (2 : ℂ) ∈ U by norm_num [U])
    (show sourcePrimitive hW 2 = Q 2 by
      simp only [Q, Function.comp_apply, Complex.conj_ofNat, sourcePrimitive_two, map_zero])
  simpa [Q, Function.comp_def] using heq (show conj s ∈ U by simpa [U] using hs)

/-!
# Laguerre--Wishart normalization boundary

Dumitriu--Edelman equation (4) gives the beta-Laguerre density normalizer.  After writing
`z = beta/2`, taking the reciprocal Gamma part, and omitting the `z`-independent factor
`Gamma(a)`, its exact relation to the beta-Hermite/Gaussian partition normalizer is

`L_{N+1}(a,z) / G_{N+1}(z) = product_{r=1}^N Gamma(a-r*z)`.

The quotient is a nonempty same-orientation negative Gamma family precisely when `N>0`.
The finite same-sign parent theorem removes every exceptional-shift condition: its HT boundary is
exactly `N>0`, for every complex shape parameter `a`.

On the classical rectangular Wishart ray `a=n*z`, the previously omitted `Gamma(a)` also varies.
The complete Laguerre/Gaussian quotient becomes the positive Gamma band

`product_{r=0}^{m-1} Gamma((n-r)*z)`.

For `m <= n`, every scale is positive, so this band is HT exactly when the observed matrix has at
least one eigenvalue.  This isolates the obstruction in the normalization of the observed
eigenvalue/time-delay spectrum, not in a temporal evolution law.
-/

/-- The negative slopes `1,...,N` in the fixed-shape beta-Laguerre/Gaussian quotient. -/

/-- Every factor in the Laguerre deformation tower has positive multiplicity one. -/
def laguerreBetaDeformationCharge (N : ℕ) (_ : Fin N) : ℤ := 1

`N+1` eigenvalues from its beta-Hermite/Gaussian counterpart. -/

  gammaNegativeNatScaleFamilyMero
    (laguerreBetaDeformationScale N)
    (laguerreBetaDeformationShift N a)

`z`-independent factor `Gamma(a)` and elementary powers of two omitted. -/

    meroField Set.univ :=
  gaussianBetaEnsemblePartitionNormalizerMero (N + 1) *
    laguerreBetaDeformationTowerMero N a

/-- The corresponding Gamma-dependent probability-density prefactor. -/

# Exact calculus of the GUP momentum deformation

arXiv:2609.02912, equations (29)--(35), uses `K = k (1 + b k²)`.
Its exact logarithmic derivative is `(1 + 3 b k²)/(1 + b k²)`.
The positive deformation below takes `b = a²` and `k = exp t`, so all
logarithms and denominators are valid for every real parameter, including zero
coupling. The negative branch has an explicit nonzero-momentum turning point.
-/

noncomputable section
namespace HTGeometry

/-- Cubic momentum deformation, with `b = beta * PlanckLength²`. -/
def gupMomentum (b k : ℝ) : ℝ := k * (1 + b * k ^ (2 : ℕ))

/-- Exact symbolic derivative of the momentum deformation. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_gupMomentum (b k : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (gupMomentum b) (1 + 3 * b * k ^ (2 : ℕ)) k := by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_id k).mul
    ((hasDerivAt_const k 1).add ((hasDerivAt_id k).pow 2 |>.const_mul b))
  exact h.congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)


/-- Logarithm of positive deformed momentum, in logarithmic input coordinates. -/
def gupLogMomentum (a t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (gupMomentum (a ^ (2 : ℕ)) (Real.exp t))

/-- The chain-rule conversion from logarithmic deformed momentum to logarithmic momentum. -/
def gupLogSlopeCorrection (a t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 + a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ)) / (1 + 3 * a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ))

theorem gupMomentum_positive (a t : ℝ) :
    0 < gupMomentum (a ^ (2 : ℕ)) (Real.exp t) := by
  unfold gupMomentum
  positivity

/-- The exact Jacobian has a cubic coefficient in its numerator. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_gupLogMomentum (a t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (gupLogMomentum a)
      ((1 + 3 * a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ)) / (1 + a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ))) t := by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_gupMomentum (a ^ (2 : ℕ)) (Real.exp t)).comp t
    (Real.hasDerivAt_exp t)).log (gupMomentum_positive a t).ne'
  convert h using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp [gupMomentum, Function.comp_def]
    field_simp

/-- Reciprocal Jacobians cancel with no exceptional positive-branch parameters. -/
theorem gupLogSlopeCorrection_inverse (a t : ℝ) :
    gupLogSlopeCorrection a t * deriv (gupLogMomentum a) t = 1 := by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_gupLogMomentum a t).deriv]
  unfold gupLogSlopeCorrection
  have h1 : 1 + a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h3 : 1 + 3 * a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

/-- Positive deformation can only reduce the exact logarithmic slope. -/
theorem gupLogSlopeCorrection_le_one (a t : ℝ) :
    gupLogSlopeCorrection a t ≤ 1 := by
  unfold gupLogSlopeCorrection
  apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).2
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * Real.exp t)]

/-- The reduction is always strictly less than a factor of three. -/
theorem one_third_lt_gupLogSlopeCorrection (a t : ℝ) :
    1 / 3 < gupLogSlopeCorrection a t := by
  unfold gupLogSlopeCorrection
  apply (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).2
  ring_nf
  linarith

/-- Exact residual of the paper's multiplier against the logarithmic chain rule. -/
theorem gup_paper_multiplier_residual (a t : ℝ) :
    (1 + a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ)) - gupLogSlopeCorrection a t =
      3 * (a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ)) * (1 + a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ)) /
        (1 + 3 * a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ)) := by
  unfold gupLogSlopeCorrection
  field_simp
  ring

/-- The paper multiplier equals the exact chain-rule factor only at zero deformation. -/
theorem gup_paper_multiplier_eq_iff (a t : ℝ) :
    (1 + a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ)) = gupLogSlopeCorrection a t ↔ a = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm := gupLogSlopeCorrection_le_one a t
    rw [← h] at hm
    have hz : a ^ (2 : ℕ) * Real.exp t ^ (2 : ℕ) = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * Real.exp t)]
    simpa [mul_eq_zero, Real.exp_ne_zero] using hz
  · rintro rfl
    simp [gupLogSlopeCorrection]

/-- A negative deformation can erase the Jacobian while momentum stays nonzero. -/
theorem gup_negative_turning_point :
    gupMomentum (-(1 / 3)) 1 = 2 / 3 ∧
      deriv (gupMomentum (-(1 / 3))) 1 = 0 := by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_gupMomentum _ _).deriv]
  norm_num [gupMomentum]

/-- A quotient-free consistency law remains meaningful at every deformation value. -/
theorem gup_consistency_polynomial (b k epsilon : ℝ) :
    (1 + b * k ^ (2 : ℕ)) * (16 * epsilon) +
      8 * (-(1 + b * k ^ (2 : ℕ)) * (2 * epsilon)) = 0 := by
  ring

/-- Exact difference factorization classifies collisions of the deformed momentum map. -/
theorem gupMomentum_difference (b k l : ℝ) :
    gupMomentum b k - gupMomentum b l =
      (k - l) * (1 + b * (k ^ (2 : ℕ) + k * l + l ^ (2 : ℕ))) := by
  unfold gupMomentum
  ring

/-- Positive deformation never identifies distinct input momenta. -/
theorem gupMomentum_sq_injective (a : ℝ) : Function.Injective (gupMomentum (a ^ (2 : ℕ))) := by
  intro k l h
  have hr := gupMomentum_difference (a ^ (2 : ℕ)) k l
  rw [h, sub_self] at hr

# The seam Krein index: definiteness as a congruence-invariant obstruction, and RH as its vanishing

The functional equation forces a self-adjoint operator on the completed zeta section with respect
to an *indefinite* Krein/Weil Gram form; its negative index `κ₋` (the maximal dimension of a
subspace on which the form is negative-definite) counts the off-critical-line zeros.  The reality
of a spectrum is not the invariant that decides the Riemann Hypothesis — the FE supplies the
operator for free — the invariant is `κ₋`, and RH is the single equation `κ₋ = 0`: the FE-forced
indefinite form is definite (admits a compatible positive polarization).

This file isolates the algebraic surface of that index, on the concrete Krein Gram matrix.  The
face `κ₋ = 0` is encoded as `KreinNonneg H := ∀ x, 0 ≤ (xᴴ H x).re` — no negative Krein direction.
Three facts make this a genuine index rather than an ad-hoc predicate:

* `kreinNonneg_iff_no_negDef` — `KreinNonneg H` is exactly `κ₋ = 0`: it holds iff every subspace on
  which the form is negative-definite is trivial.  This is the definiteness ⟺ index-zero
  equivalence (a positive polarization ⟺ the negative index vanishes).
* `kreinNonneg_congr` — `KreinNonneg` is invariant under invertible congruence `H ↦ Pᴴ H P`
  (Sylvester rigidity): `κ₋` is a property of the *form*, basis-free, hence a deformation
  invariant — the "structurally pinned" computation, not a re-count.
* `krein_smul_re` — the Krein value scales by `‖c‖²`, the sign-homogeneity that makes a single
  negative direction span a negative-definite line.

The reduction `riemannHypothesis_of_seam_polarization` is the index-prong analogue of the
residual-face gate: modulo the *argument principle* (an off-line zero forces a negative Krein
direction — the identity `κ₋ = ` off-line count, supplied as an interface), RH follows from the
single geometric clause that the seam Gram admits a positive polarization (`KreinNonneg`).  The
biconditional `riemannHypothesis_iff_seam_polarization` records that this is an *equivalence*: RH
holds iff the FE-forced Krein form is everywhere definite.  No operator or carrier is constructed;
definiteness is a constraint on a given form, and its invariance under congruence is what pins it.
-/

/-
The seam sign bit: a second deformation invariant on the critical line.

The critical line of an FE + Schwarz-symmetric member is real: on `s = ½+iτ` the reflection
`s ↦ 1 − s` and the Schwarz conjugation `s ↦ conj s` coincide (`conj s = 1 − s`), so
`f(s) = f(1−s) = f(conj s) = conj f(s)`, forcing `f(s)` real. Where the restriction is nonvanishing
it therefore carries a sign, and that sign is a deformation invariant alongside the deck charge:
a continuous nonvanishing real family cannot change sign, so the sign bit at a line anchor is
conserved by any boundary-nonvanishing deformation. Off-line zeros are exactly the defects that
carry deck charge yet are invisible to this seam sign data; an odd on-line defect flips the sign
between anchors bracketing it, and a sign bracket on the seam is undeformable — an on-line zero is
pinned between anchors whose product of real restrictions is negative.
-/
import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.GoldilocksTrichotomy
import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.HardyCarrier
import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.ConnectedSymmetryBarrier

open Complex

namespace RHTower

/-- **Reality on the seam.**  An FE + Schwarz-symmetric member is real-valued on the critical line:
on `s = ½+iτ` the functional-equation reflection and the Schwarz conjugation coincide
(`conj s = 1 − s`), so `f s = f (1 − s) = f (conj s) = conj (f s)`, hence `f s` equals its own
conjugate and is real. Only the FE and Schwarz clauses are used. -/
theorem fESchwarz_real_on_line {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : FESchwarz f) (τ : ℝ) :
    (f (linePt τ)).im = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_, hfe, hconj⟩ := hf
  have key : (starRingEnd ℂ) (f (linePt τ)) = f (linePt τ) := by
    have h1 := hconj (linePt τ)
    rw [conj_linePt] at h1
    rw [hfe (linePt τ)] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp key

/-- **Seam sign conservation.**  Along a family whose restriction to a fixed line point `linePt τ` is
continuous, real, and nonvanishing in the deformation parameter, the sign of the real part is
conserved: a continuous never-zero real function cannot change sign between the endpoints, since the
intermediate value theorem would otherwise produce a zero. -/
theorem line_sign_conserved {F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ} {τ : ℝ}
    (hc : Continuous fun t : ℝ => F t (linePt τ))
    (hreal : ∀ t : ℝ, (F t (linePt τ)).im = 0)
    (hnv : ∀ t : ℝ, F t (linePt τ) ≠ 0) :
    (0 < (F 0 (linePt τ)).re ↔ 0 < (F 1 (linePt τ)).re) := by
  have hgc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (F t (linePt τ)).re) := Complex.continuous_re.comp hc
  have hgne : ∀ t : ℝ, (F t (linePt τ)).re ≠ 0 := by
    intro t hgt
    exact hnv t (Complex.ext hgt (hreal t))
  have hcon : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => (F t (linePt τ)).re) (Set.Icc 0 1) := hgc.continuousOn
  constructor
  · intro h0
    by_contra h1
    have h1' : (F 1 (linePt τ)).re < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) (hgne 1)
    have hmem : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((F 1 (linePt τ)).re) ((F 0 (linePt τ)).re) := ⟨h1'.le, h0.le⟩
    obtain ⟨c, _, hc0⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) hcon hmem
    exact hgne c hc0
  · intro h1
    by_contra h0
    have h0' : (F 0 (linePt τ)).re < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h0) (hgne 0)
    have hmem : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((F 0 (linePt τ)).re) ((F 1 (linePt τ)).re) := ⟨h0'.le, h1.le⟩
    obtain ⟨c, _, hc0⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) hcon hmem
    exact hgne c hc0

/-- **Two conserved seam invariants.**  A deformation of window pairs conserves a *pair* of
quantities: the deck charge at every level (`boxCharge_conserved_moving`) and the seam sign bit at
each of two line anchors (`line_sign_conserved`). An odd on-line defect flips the sign between
anchors bracketing it, while any off-line mirror pair is invisible to both anchors — carrying deck
charge without touching the seam sign data. -/
theorem seam_two_invariants_conserved (k : ℕ) {F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℝ → ℂ} {r : ℝ → ℝ}
    {τ₁ τ₂ : ℝ}
    (hc : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 (c p.1 + ↑(r p.1) * exp (I * ↑p.2)))
    (hnv : ∀ σ θ : ℝ, F σ (c σ + ↑(r σ) * exp (I * ↑θ)) ≠ 0)
    (hc₁ : Continuous fun t : ℝ => F t (linePt τ₁))
    (hreal₁ : ∀ t : ℝ, (F t (linePt τ₁)).im = 0)
    (hnv₁ : ∀ t : ℝ, F t (linePt τ₁) ≠ 0)
    (hc₂ : Continuous fun t : ℝ => F t (linePt τ₂))
    (hreal₂ : ∀ t : ℝ, (F t (linePt τ₂)).im = 0)
    (hnv₂ : ∀ t : ℝ, F t (linePt τ₂) ≠ 0) :
    boxCharge k (F 0) (c 0) (r 0) = boxCharge k (F 1) (c 1) (r 1) ∧
      (0 < (F 0 (linePt τ₁)).re ↔ 0 < (F 1 (linePt τ₁)).re) ∧
      (0 < (F 0 (linePt τ₂)).re ↔ 0 < (F 1 (linePt τ₂)).re) :=
  ⟨boxCharge_conserved_moving k hc hnv,
    line_sign_conserved hc₁ hreal₁ hnv₁,
    line_sign_conserved hc₂ hreal₂ hnv₂⟩

/-- **Bracket pinning.**  A sign bracket on the seam is undeformable: if at the initial time the real
restrictions at two line anchors have opposite signs (negative product), then at the final time —
after any deformation keeping both anchors nonvanishing — an on-line zero survives between them.
